about: The community post after the 19 changes of his answers of 1 November went in. Joel, 2026-11-01 20:26 UTC: "i didn't make the edits to community guide, that's too much. you can do that." (joel-20261101-2026-message.txt, with his editor's HTML, EDITOR-BEFORE-20261101-2026.html). In the app's browser (his Substack, signed in), the post's editor (https://ibogaqueen.substack.com/publish/post/198340475) held each of the 19 "Find" strings of ../SUBSTACK-EDITS.md once, each inside one run of text with no marks; the 19 replacements went in as one editor transaction (each old string then 0 times, each new one once), the editor saved, and Update, then "Update now" in Substack's dialog (audience and settings untouched), put them live. The title already read "Updated: Nov 1 2026" in the saved editor (not changed by me). Then the public post was read through Substack's API without signing in.
